regions.merged_text: His Eminence John Card. Farley returned from Rome .... Altogether Sixty-one persons from the school and Monastery went to the Cath-dral to see him. These included Rev. Fr. Burchman, -Solanus, 8 sisters, 9 students and the rest Altar boys & Singers. We made a visit to Jesus on leaving Cathedral and asked Him to be with us

regions.merged_text: Former Altar boy, Fr. Keegan Sad accident with gun. while after a rat with his Father accidently discharged the gun from which his Father died the following Sunday night - resigned to God's will and well prepared with - Sacraments. Poor Frank was nearly heart broken.
